conclusion: The setup wizard's first profile build should use PresetBundle::load_vendors inside a bounded task arena rather than the legacy serial per-vendor loop. Four workers reduced the measured first-start profile build on the Windows host from about 23 seconds to about 11.9 seconds; unrestricted parallelism was slower. The existing ordered merge and cancellation behavior is retained. The second start used the existing profile cache in about 0.38 seconds, and normalized profile JSON was identical.
